text.p: Swiss freight forwarding and logistics company, Danzas said it had taken 100 percent control of Helsinki-based company, Victor Ek.

"The acquisition of Victor Ek is an essential step towards realising our long-term strategy in this region with Finland being the 47th country where we are present with our own organisation," said Danzas' chief executive officer, Peter Wagner.
Until now, Danzas activities in Finland were via agreements with several forwarding groups in the country, one of whom was Victor Ek.

From April 1 1997, Danzas will create its own division in Finland, Danzas Oy, operating centres in Helsinki, Turku and Vaasa and generating an annual turnover from sea, air and overland forwarding activities of around 40 million Swiss francs, Danzas said in a statement.

"The new organisation will provide Danzas' worldwide customers with a wide range of continental and intercontinental logistics services and will serve as a gateway to the Baltic states as well as the CIS countries."
Danzas 1995 net sales from airfreight forwarding totalled 584 million Swiss francs from global net sales of 4.02 million Swiss francs. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
